business_problem: Cartesia needed a globally distributed infrastructure for ultra-low-latency voice AI so developers could deploy realistic speech models and voice agents without sacrificing uptime, data control, or rapid scaling.
solution_summary: Cartesia uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Cartesia needed a globally distributed infrastructure for ultra-low-latency voice AI so developers could deploy realistic speech models and voice agents without sacrificing uptime, data control, or rapid scaling. Model Garden on Vertex AI gives Cartesia access to frontier models and a managed foundation for voice AI development, serving as the compute layer. Google Kubernetes Engine handles orchestration and auto-scaling so voice AI models stay close to demand in multiple data centers, serving as the orchestration layer. Cloud Storage manages and secures production data needed to deploy voice AI workloads, serving as the storage layer. Gemini adds sophisticated reasoning capabilities to the end-to-end Line voice-agent platform, serving as the compute layer.
